bh_words: Scanning many names guarantees some pass by chance. Before any name may show SUPPORTED, its episode record is corrected for how many names were scanned (a Benjamini-Hochberg correction across the whole scan); a name that passes its own bars but not the correction is shown as MIXED, with the reason kept.
idea_words: Each name earns a proof state from its own past: the times its own entry pattern appeared before, and what the name did in the 10 trading days after each one, split into an earlier training part and a later holdout part, with a small cost taken off every episode. Every state here is provisional: it is built from the name's own history at scan time, not from a forward record, and it is written to the forward record so it can be checked against what the name does next.
